subject: Kickoff: Project Quillon - exploration-method bake-off
body:
Jelena, Yusuf,

Kickoff note for the exploration bake-off. Internally we're calling this Project Quillon - please use that name in decks and OKR docs so leadership can track it.

Why now: two prospective customers have sparse-reward control problems, and we keep hand-waving "use an exploration bonus" without a defensible recommendation. Our open-source release already implements the three families that matter - NoisyNetworks, pseudo-counts with PixelCNN, and Random Network Distillation - on the Arcade Learning Environment, so the plan is a disciplined head-to-head under matched budgets rather than new research.

Deliverable by May 11: a ranked recommendation with per-family cost curves, plus a one-pager for the sales team. Milestones: harness ready Mar 6, sweeps complete Apr 17, report + readout by May 8.

Jelena, staffing thoughts by Friday?

Dmitri
